title: Juicy Sweet Korean Cranberry Songpyeon
description: A funky and snappy Korean dish featuring cranberry juice, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and formed into songpyeon.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine rice flour, sugar, and salt.
Gradually add in cranberry juice, sesame oil, and water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each into a disk shape.
Place a few dried cranberries in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat the deep-fry-tod oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
Fry the songpyeon until they are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the songpyeon on paper towels and serve warm.
Mix cornstarch and egg in a small bowl to make a glaze and brush over the songpyeon before serving.
